name: ultraia
description: UltraIa — AI that creates AI and learns from AI. Generate purpose-built agents from a task description and improve them from usage feedback.

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @ultraia/core && npm run typecheck -w @ultraia/web && npm run typecheck -w @ultraia/runtime
scripts.test: npm run test -w @ultraia/core && npm run test -w @ultraia/runtime
scripts.test:cov: npm run test:cov -w @ultraia/core && npm run test:cov -w @ultraia/runtime
scripts.test:ci: npm run test:ci -w @ultraia/core && npm run test:ci -w @ultraia/runtime
scripts.harness:test: py -3.12 scripts/loop_piv_doctor.test.py && py -3.12 scripts/loop_piv_mark_done.test.py && py -3.12 scripts/state_doctor.test.py && py -3.12 scripts/loop_triage.test.py && py -3.12 scripts/sync_skill_mirrors.test.py
